{"consolidated_memory":"## Intermittent EOF in crypto/tls/handshake.go — Two Separate Incidents

### Incident 1: April 4, 2026 — Clock Skew Issue
**File:** crypto/tls/handshake.go (security side)
**Problem:** Intermittent EOF during TLS handshake
**Trigger:** Affected clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
**Repro:** Open many short-lived connections in a row
**Root Cause:** Clock skew between the two hosts
**Signal:** Unexpected end of stream during negotiation
**Fix:** Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock (PR #2202 on branch fix/intermittent-eof-1)
**Result:** Flaky test failures reduced from 57 per hundred runs to zero
**Context:** Same corner of crypto/tls/handshake.go as earlier intermittent EOF work, so context carried over

### Incident 2: July 18, 2026 — Bare Except Swallowing Errors
**File:** crypto/tls/handshake.go (security side)
**Problem:** Intermittent EOF during TLS handshake
**Trigger:** Appeared after a rolling restart of the fleet
**Repro:** Open many short-lived connections in a row
**Root Cause:** An error swallowed by a bare except handler
**Signal:** Unexpected end of stream during negotiation
**Fix:** Narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate (PR #8009 on branch fix/intermittent-eof-2)
**Result:** Reclaimed 48 GB of blob storage
**Stack:** Go
**Covering Test:** crypto/tls/handshake_test.go"}
